items.docs:
This endpoint will be used to perform a OAuth 2 - client credentials token
request.

The path in this endpoint can be the same as the `/token` path the only requirement is that a different set of 
`client_id` and `client_secret` credentials are shared by the 3rd party to Switchfly as this token request will
be triggered to perform a **machine to machine** authentication which will then allow Switchfly to perform API
requests to a secured `/refund` endpoint.
